text: This staff report is about a matter for which the North York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This is a report on the refusal to issue a permit by Municipal Licensing and Standards in the matter of an application for a boulevard café permit located at 955 Mount Pleasant Road, Erskine Avenue flankage.
North York Community Council 1. Approved the application for the proposed boulevard café located at 955 Mount Pleasant Road, Erskine Avenue flankage.
